name: Valladolid (Spain)
description: Crimson field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Valladolid (flames on red within a laurel wreath, with the Laureate Cross of Saint Ferdinand).
history: The flag of Valladolid is crimson, the colour characteristic of Castilian municipalities, with the arms of Valladolid at the centre; the Laureate Cross of Saint Ferdinand, the highest Spanish military decoration, was granted to the city by the Francoist authorities on 17 July 1939.
